craft_notes: Sthāyin: ordinance calm. Rows: servant catalogue. Read aloud: even tread.

lines: What returns on time is daily; to be That, the feastly;
its servants — dusk-praise, practice, feast-day, sacred thread.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra niyatabhavaṃ nityaṃ tanmayībhāva eva naimittikaṃ tadupayogi saṃdhyopāsanaṃ pratyaham anuṣṭhānaṃ parvadinaṃ pavitrakam ityādi
